sources.supports: Installed 4.0.10.213 catalog names and categories only.
Four selected parameter strips and their session values; not defaults or ranges.
Current DJ effect membership; a few names have spelling/spacing differences from the app.
Shared FX controls, channel assignment, beat scaling, tempo and banks.
Selection versus enable, parameter reset, save and USER presets.
Serato states all FX were redesigned for 3.2.0. Historical iZotope FX cannot establish current algorithms.
HEX FX is a separate product. Its detailed parameter inventory is not evidence for DJ Pro parameter parity.
Describes endless Infinity Filter sweeps and one-direction Infinity Flanger in HEX; provides design inspiration only, not DJ Pro proof.
Custom audio processing on the audio rendering thread; implementation mechanism, not vendor fidelity.
Available standard filter types and controls; implementation mechanism only.
All59 visible advanced strips;236 labels, session values and source-image hashes. Ranges, enum alternatives and sonic behavior remain unmeasured.

shared_reference_contracts: Two units with individual channel assignments; master assignment excludes individual channels.
Beat duration is 60/BPM times the selected beat value.
Depth usually spans dry to wet; the manual qualifies this, so Out FX require separate measurement.
A-D banks recall effects and unit beat values. Advanced selection is distinct from effect enable.
Advanced presets can be saved under USER and reset to defaults.
shared_independent_acceptance: All values remain finite at minimum/default/maximum controls, including zero input.
Depth zero nulls against a latency-aligned dry reference below -90 dBFS unless an explicitly documented generator mode is selected.
Changing an assigned unit audibly affects only its assigned channels; master assignment affects the complete mix exactly once.
Processor state survives UI redraws; bypass/re-enable behavior is specified and tested.
Test at both 44.1 and 48 kHz, mono/stereo, and BPM 60/120/180; sample-rate changes preserve seconds/beat timing.
Use 5 ms or longer parameter ramps where appropriate to prevent switching clicks; capture/retrigger crossfades are explicit.
Delay/reverb tails keep processing after source silence until decay completes; stop-all clears feedback buffers and prevents orphan voices.
A slider test must demonstrate measured audio change, not only a label or state update.
Record real UI paths as well as offline signal tests; a processor test alone does not establish the routed browser behavior.
